title: trisetum wrangelense
intro: Trisetum wrangelense, commonly known as Wrangel's Hair Grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is native to the island of Wrangel Island in the Arctic Ocean. The health benefits of Wrangel's Hair Grass include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve antioxidant activity, which may contribute to its ability to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Wrangel's Hair Grass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenoids, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids that may exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
